Township of Langley · Council term 2022–2026

What Council decided, who moved it and how each member voted

Independent summary, not affiliated with the Township of Langley. Every recorded Council vote from November 2022 to July 2026, read from the Township of Langley's official meeting minutes (65 sets), with the motion text, who moved and seconded it, the result and each member's vote. Ten people served on Council this term: Misty vanPopta left in 2025 and Blair Whitmarsh joined in November 2025. Routine motions such as adopting the agenda or adjourning are left out.

Compiled from public council records. This page may contain transcription or processing errors; the linked official records are authoritative. Spotted a mistake? Email georgesteinberg15@gmail.com.

About NO votes

A NO vote applies to the specific motion shown. It does not necessarily mean the councillor opposed the underlying project or issue. Council frequently votes on amendments, referrals, timing changes and procedural motions before voting on the final proposal. Read the motion text before interpreting a NO vote.

Council record

Voting is one part of a councillor’s record. This table starts with the motions each member moved and seconded, as recorded in the official minutes, followed by how they voted. Select a name for the motions that member moved.

Counts are factual tallies of recorded actions. They are not scores, and a count of votes opposed does not show a position on any issue.

Issues

Choose a topic to see its votes in date order. A vote can carry more than one tag. Tags are assigned by this site from keywords in each motion’s title and text, and some placements are judgment calls.

About this data

Interpreting voting records

Voting records show how members voted on individual motions, but they do not by themselves show who developed or introduced an initiative. Where the minutes name them, this site therefore also identifies the councillor who moved and seconded each motion.

A vote against an amendment, referral or procedural motion should also not automatically be interpreted as opposition to the underlying issue.

The site presents the motion text and official minutes so users can review the context themselves. It does not rate members or describe them as supporters or opponents of an issue.

Source

The Township of Langley's Council meeting minutes: 65 sets of Regular, Special and Inaugural Council minutes from 7 November 2022 to 27 July 2026, retrieved 7 October 2026. Each vote links to its minutes and, where the minutes give one, to the point in the meeting video where the item starts.

The official record is authoritative. Where this page and the official record differ, the official record is correct.

How votes were counted

The Township records each result as “CARRIED” or “DEFEATED”, followed by a line naming those opposed. Members named there are counted against; everyone else present is counted in favour. Attendance comes from each meeting's present list, adjusted where the minutes note that a member entered, left, re-entered or declared a conflict of interest.

Mover and seconder

The minutes introduce each motion with “Moved by …, Seconded by …”. Those names are shown exactly as recorded. When a motion was amended, the vote on the main motion shows the mover and seconder of the motion that was on the floor when the amendment was moved, with a note. The mover is never inferred.

Limits

  • Votes on a main motion “as amended” show the motion as first moved, because the minutes do not reprint the amended wording. Each carries a note.
  • About 3% of result lines could not be tied to a motion and are left out.
  • Public Hearings, committee meetings and closed meetings are not included.
  • Each reading of a bylaw is its own vote.

Types of motion

Each vote is labelled Main motion, Amendment, Referral, Postponement, Reconsideration, Procedural or Other, based on how the minutes describe it and on the wording of the motion. “Procedural” here mostly means receiving a report for information. The labels are assigned by this site and are a guide; the motion text is shown in full.

How this page was made

The data was compiled with AI assistance. Software read each set of minutes and extracted the votes, motion text, movers and seconders; the results were checked against samples of the originals, not vote by vote. This page may therefore contain transcription or processing errors.

Corrections. If something here looks wrong, please email georgesteinberg15@gmail.com with the date and item. Corrections from council members, staff and residents are all welcome and will be checked against the official record.

Privacy. Names of residents and applicants given as an initial and surname are removed from the motion text.

Visitor counts. This site counts page visits with GoatCounter, which uses no cookies and does not identify or track individual visitors.
